headline: As of 2026-10-11: 3,186,450 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+25.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,186,450 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+25.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (519,306), Florida (501,167), Michigan (386,495).
